findings.title: Rated life (L70)
findings.detail: L90 60000 hours is quoted; lumen output only declines, so L70 is at least as long. Spec requires at least 50000 hr.

findings.title: Warranty
findings.detail: Package states 5 years; spec requires at least 5 yr.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: DLC listing
findings.detail: Listed as a qualified DLC product, where applicable.
findings.why_it_matters: Without DLC confirmation, we can’t verify eligibility for energy rebates or compliance with project sustainability goals.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: macadam steps
findings.detail: LEDs shall be binned within a maximum 3-step MacAdam Ellipse.
findings.why_it_matters: LEDs outside the 3-step MacAdam Ellipse may show noticeable color differences between fixtures, affecting lighting quality in office spaces.

findings.title: Specify option: Dims down to
findings.detail: Dims down to meets the spec only with EZB (0.1 %). Confirm the order specifies it.
findings.why_it_matters: If the dimming isn’t set to go low enough, the lights won’t perform as needed for tasks like presentations or evening work, reducing usability.

configure.quote: EZB eldoLED dims to  0.1% (0-10 volt dimming)

findings.title: Product Availability Issue
findings.detail: The manufacturer lists it as discontinued.
findings.why_it_matters: A discontinued product can’t be sourced for this job or future maintenance, risking delays and long-term support problems.
